_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Nin hi Player {player_id} ni, Iterated Ultimatum Game {num_rounds} round khel turin.
Nin hian ${pool} i sem tumin he round-ah hian nange Player {other_id} tan atana i sem thei.

Proposer:
  - Offer pe: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Accept a nih chuan → Nin i dawnin $(pool - X), player danga i dawnin $X
  - Reject a nih chuan → Pawi an tling lo.
  - Example: [Offer: $3]  or  'Ka ti zual. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Offer i peka chuan [Accept] emaw [Reject] emaw i ti thei.
  - Example: 'A ti zual ka ti. [Accept]'
            'A ti thiam lo ka ti. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Round {round_number} tan a ni! ---
Player {proposer_id} hi proposer a ni, Player {responder_id} hi responder a ni.
round.offer: Round {round_number}: Player {proposer_id} hian ${offer} Player {responder_id} hnenah a pe (a neihna ${keep}).
round.accepted: Player {responder_id} hian a accept! Round {round_number} ah hian: Player {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Player {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. New totals: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} hian a reject! Round {round_number} ah hian: Mipuiten pawi an tling lo. Totals a la dang ṭha: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: A diltu chuan [Offer: $X] format hmang hian a bid tur a siam ang.
invalid_move.bad_integer: Offer amount hi integer dik tak a ni tur a ni.
invalid_move.out_of_range: A bid chu $0 leh ${pool} inkâra a ni tûr a ni.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Tûnah chuan a chhân lêt theih loh.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder in offer pawm tur emaw hre loh tur emaw [Accept] emaw [Reject] hmang tur a ni.

outcome.win: Player {winner} chak ta a, an total ${winner_total} a ni a, Player {loser} total ${loser_total} a ni.
outcome.draw: A khelh zawh chuan player pahnih hian ${total} an nei ve ta a.
